g.title:
10. Nigerian Financial Ecosystem, Regulators & Telecom Carriers [External Ecosystem Tier] ================================================================================ 1. WHAT IT DOES: Encompasses the mandatory national payment rails (NIBSS Instant Payments, NACS, BVN), the banking regulator (Central Bank of Nigeria Extranet RTGS/CRMS/S4), Interswitch payment gateway, NIMC identity verification, and 14 contracted telecom carrier networks.
2. ROLE IN WHOLE ARCHITECTURE: Enables interbank clearing, instant fund transfers, national settlement, regulatory supervision compliance, card acquiring, and telecom WAN transport across Nigeria.
3. HOW IT CONNECTS TO OTHERS: • INBOUND: Postilion Switch via ISO 8583 (Ports 9000-9100), Core Middleware via Secure HTTPS (Port 443), Branch SD-WAN via MPLS/Cellular Underlays • OUTBOUND: Finacle Core Banking Settlement Accounts, Beneficiary Banks across Nigerian Financial System • FAILOVER: Dual redundant MPLS circuits to NIBSS data centers (Victoria Island & Ikeja), 14 contracted telcos ensuring carrier diversity, and automated BGP routing failover. • SECURITY: Dedicated private MPLS leased lines, hardware HSM MAC verification, 3DES/AES PIN translation, and strict IP whitelisting. (Click box on diagram for interactive detail view)
g.text: 10. NIGERIAN FINANCIAL ECOSYSTEM, REGULATORS & TELECOM CARRIERS
National payment clearing house & instant settlement rail:
• NIBSS Instant Payments (NIP): Real-time interbank credit transfer (ISO 8583 / REST)
• BVN Validation Service: Real-time Biometric Verification Number identity verification
• NACS Automated Clearing: Cheque clearing and Direct Debit settlement
• Connection: Dedicated MPLS circuits to NIBSS Victoria Island & Ikeja Data Centers
Apex regulatory extranet network & high-value RTGS settlement:
• Real-Time Gross Settlement (RTGS): High-value interbank inter-account settlement
• CRMS / Credit Bureau: Mandatory Credit Risk Management System reporting
• S4 Regulatory Reporting: Daily liquidity ratios, foreign exchange returns
National card switching & digital merchant acquiring:
• Verve Card Acquiring: Real-time domestic debit card transaction routing
• Quickteller & Webpay: Merchant online payment gateway & bills processing
• Connection: Dual redundant cross-connect to Primary DC Postilion Switch
• Real-time National Identification Number (NIN) authentication via secure API
• Mandatory tier-3 KYC compliance requirement for account opening
• Encrypted TLS 1.3 VPN tunnel to NIMC verification gateway
• SMPP USSD Aggregation: Sessions routed to Huawei Cloud USSD Service
• Bulk SMS Notifications: High-throughput transactional alert delivery
• SIP Voice Trunks: Inbound/outbound call routing to Avaya Call Center
• Protocol: SMPP over IPsec VPN / SIP over TLS
• Metro Fiber Ring in Victoria Island / Lekki
• Connecting Primary DC to DR DC
• Dedicated Private APN for POS Terminals
